answer: Seed canary submissions, deliberately flawed answers, as traps scattered like wildflowers in a meadow across the grading pool. Honest jurors standing on the open mesa flag them as junk; any grader who rubber-stamps a planted canary exposes collusion and is slashed, their bond tumbling into the canyon. Attacker cost: every Sybil juror must independently detect each trap or forfeit staked capital, so adding fake graders multiplies the odds of getting caught rather than amortizing one lazy vote.
